text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: .........Dammit. That trainer just talks whatever crap she wants.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(—Every last one of 'em pisses me off.
It's been like that forever.)

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Your shoes~? Ah, yeah, I saw 'em!
...Way up in that tree!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, looks like you're gonna have to jump suuuper high.
Otherwise you'll never reach 'em!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey~, someone go sit next to her~.
Isn't it pitiful seeing her all alone?!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ew, no way, I don't wanna! She's so gloomy!
Let's just play rock-paper-scissors and make the loser do it~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Teasing me and looking down on me for the stupidest reasons.
I never wanted to play nice with them anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Every day was irritating, frustrating as hell.
But that's why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The only thing that was good... was racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Hah*, *hah*, *hah*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's insane...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that... seriously that loner,
pint-sized Narita Taishin... Heh?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Racing was the only good thing. Because if I ran and won,
I could show up every annoying punk and jerk who ever mocked me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Past the finish line, leaving them all in the dust.
...That was the only place where it felt like I could breathe easy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I threw myself deeper and deeper into racing.
I even thought I'd conquer the Twinkle Series, but—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: *Haah*, *haah*... Aight, 1st plaaace!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*, *haah*... *haah*.
...Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. You're Narita Taishin, right?
I heard you're going to Tracen Academy this spring, is that for real?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What's it to you?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Nah, nothing really. Just wondering what you're thinking, is all.
That's the top academy, where monsters with insane talent and size gather, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: —There's no way someone as tiny as you could ever cut it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up." "Quiet." "Just shut your mouth and watch."—
I had so much I wanted to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: .........Every bit of it is still stuck in the back of my throat, even now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Haah*, *haah*, *haah*, *haah*...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit... Dammit, dammit, what is with these guys? They're on a completely different level!
Their positioning has zero openings! I can't break forward at all...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Is this... Tracen Academy...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Haah*, *haah*, *haah*... *ugh*, *gh*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (I can't...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (...breathe right...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like hell... I'm gonna let it end like this...!!

Even though lights-out had long passed, I spotted a small silhouette on the track.
Thinking it couldn't be, I went to check—
And just as I suspected, "she" was there, looking utterly cornered.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Haah*... *haah*...

Seeing her so exhausted that she looked ready to collapse at any second,
I couldn't help calling out—
choice_data_list: You're pushing yourself way too hard!
You're pushing yourself way too hard!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What's your problem...?
choice_data_list: If you keep going like this, you're going to get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up. It's none of your business.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tch... AAAAAARGH, enough already!!
Every single one of you is so damn noisy!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Don't push yourself," "It's dangerous to keep going"—and what's next?!
You're gonna tell me "You're not cut out for this" too, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Your body's too small"! "Your limbs are too skinny"!
"You're not the kind of horsegirl who belongs in a race"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm sick and tired of hearing every single bit of it...!!

Her sheer fury rendered me speechless.
Yet, as she screamed as if bursting a dam, her eyes—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, get this! No matter what anyone says, I'm standing on that turf!
And to everyone who mocked me and looked down on me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna stand in the Winner's Circle and laugh right in their faces,
'Serve you right, THIS is where I belong!'!!
What dwelt within those eyes was, without question—
A fierce and unyielding thirst for victory.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
AAAAAAAHHH--!!
Th-There you are, TAISHIIIIN--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What're you doing out here this late?! The track lights are already off,
that's dangerous, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Annoying... What did you even come here for?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To come get you, obviously!
You weren't coming back to the dorm at all, so I was worried sick, Taishin~...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't ask you to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaah?! W-Wait up, TAISHIIIIN--!!
And so, left alone on the track...
I felt my heart begin to beat faster, savoring the surge of excitement.
